en_title: Judi Dench Reveals Daniel Craig Pushed to Kill Off M in Skyfall
cn_title: 朱迪·丹奇透露丹尼尔·克雷格力主让M在《007：大破天幕杀机》中死去
opus_summary: 朱迪·丹奇在新回忆录中称，让M在《007：大破天幕杀机》中死去似乎是丹尼尔·克雷格的主意。她还透露，《007之明日帝国》是拍摄难度最高的邦德电影，剧本似乎一直在改动。此外，据报道，新任邦德演员的寻找已进入最后阶段，三名演员处于领跑位置。

paragraphs.en: Dame Judi Dench, who portrayed 007’s boss M in eight James Bond films over 20 years, claims that Daniel Craig was responsible for having her character die in 2012’s Skyfall .
paragraphs.cn: 朱迪·丹奇女爵士在20年间的八部詹姆斯·邦德电影中饰演007的上司M，她称是丹尼尔·克雷格促成了她的角色在2012年的《007：大破天幕杀机》中死去。

paragraphs.en: Variety published an excerpt from Dench’s new memoir “Is It Too Late to Make a Run For It?” wherein the Oscar winner recalled how she found out that M was going to be killed off.
paragraphs.cn: 综艺刊登了丹奇新回忆录《Is It Too Late to Make a Run For It?》的节选，这位奥斯卡奖得主在书中回忆了自己是如何得知M将被写死的。

paragraphs.en: “I was taken to the Wolseley restaurant by Barbara, Michael and Sam [Mendes, the director] – I don’t think Daniel Craig was there – and they outlined the plot and told me they were going to bump me off. My own fault, I suppose,” Dench said, in a somewhat tongue-in-cheek manner . “Ever since GoldenEye , when the entire film unit went off to Monte Carlo and St. Petersburg and I only had three days in Watford, I’d been begging them to let me out from behind my desk. Well, they did finally let me out from behind my desk … and they shot me.”
paragraphs.cn: 「芭芭拉、迈克尔和山姆［导演门德斯］带我去了Wolseley餐厅——我记得丹尼尔·克雷格不在场——他们向我概述了剧情，告诉我他们打算干掉我。我想，这都怪我自己，」丹奇略带戏谑地说。「从拍《007之黄金眼》的时候起，我就一直求他们让我离开办公桌。那时整个剧组都去了Monte Carlo和St. Petersburg，而我只在Watford待了三天。好吧，他们最终确实让我离开了办公桌……然后开枪打死了我。」

paragraphs.en: Dench – who first played the role in 1995’s GoldenEye opposite Pierce Brosnan in his debut as James Bond – then named who decided it was time for her M to finally get the axe. (Dench’s M did make a posthumous cameo in SPECTRE .)
paragraphs.cn: 丹奇在1995年的《007之黄金眼》中首次饰演这个角色，与首次扮演詹姆斯·邦德的皮尔斯·布鲁斯南合作。随后，她说出了是谁决定让她饰演的M最终退场的。（丹奇饰演的M确实在死后于《007：幽灵党》中客串亮相。）

paragraphs.en: “Apparently, it was Daniel’s idea to have me killed. But first I had to suffer the indignity of being sacked by Ralph Fiennes. Arsehole. [Laughs.],” Dench said.
paragraphs.cn: 丹奇说：「显然，让我被杀是丹尼尔的主意。但首先我还得忍受被拉尔夫·费因斯解雇的屈辱。混蛋。［笑］」

paragraphs.en: Dench also revealed that 1997’s Tomorrow Never Dies was the most difficult Bond film to make, citing “a general air of chaos” that consumed the production.
paragraphs.cn: 丹奇还透露，1997年的《007之明日帝国》是拍摄起来最困难的邦德电影，她提到了笼罩整个制作过程的「一种普遍的混乱氛围」。

paragraphs.en: “Making a film is nerve-racking enough – at least it is for me – and to be presented with a load of rewrites last minute is very destabilizing: there are whole new chunks of information to take in – not to mention new lines to learn – that you haven’t had the time to examine,” Dench said.
paragraphs.cn: 丹奇说：「拍电影已经够让人紧张的了——至少对我来说是这样——而在最后一刻收到大批修改过的内容会让人非常不安：有大段全新的信息需要消化，更不用说还要学习新台词，而你根本没有时间仔细看过这些内容。」

paragraphs.en: “Every day we’d be presented with new scenes. On one occasion I arrived home at ten o’clock at night only to be greeted by a motorcycle courier with a dozen new pages to be learnt before my pick-up at five AM the following morning. I mean, when the hell would I have a chance to learn all that? It’s not unusual to have rewrites on a film, but the script for Tomorrow Never Dies seemed to be in a permanent state of flux.”
paragraphs.cn: 「每天都会有新场景交到我们手上。有一次，我晚上十点到家，却发现一名摩托车快递员在等我，送来了十几页新内容，我得在第二天早上五点有人来接我之前学会。我是说，我到底什么时候才有机会学完那些东西？电影拍摄时修改剧本并不罕见，但《007之明日帝国》的剧本似乎一直处于变动之中。」

paragraphs.en: In related news, new Bond studio Amazon MGM Studios’ search for the next actor to play James Bond is coming down to the wire, with Callum Turner, Jack Lowden and Josh O’Connor reportedly the frontrunners to succeed Daniel Craig.
paragraphs.cn: 相关新闻方面，邦德系列的新制片公司Amazon MGM Studios寻找下一任詹姆斯·邦德扮演者的工作正进入最后关头。据报道，卡勒姆·特纳、杰克·劳登和乔什·奥康纳是接替丹尼尔·克雷格的领跑人选。

paragraphs.en: Jim Vejvoda (he/him) is IGN's Assoc. Director of Entertainment Content.
paragraphs.cn: Jim Vejvoda（他）是IGN的娱乐内容副总监。
